title: How HAX grew
eyebrow: Growth, reuse and what it saves
failed: The growth data could not be loaded.
chartHint: On a log scale a straight climb means steady multiplying, and a bend upward means it is speeding up.
cacheSite: Cache: page to page, site to site
rateThemes: {n} new themes in the 12 months to {date}: about one every {days} days.
rate30: {n} new themes in the last 30 days.
noThemes: No new themes in the 12 months to {date}.
preCore: These first themes come before the shared theme core, which arrives on {date}; every theme here is later built on it.
coreText: Every theme loads the same shared core: {core} gzipped across {files} files. A typical theme adds {own} of its own, about {pct}% of the core. Hexagons are drawn to that scale.
selectTheme: Select a theme to compare it with the core.
themeCost: A first visit to a {name} site loads {first}. After a visitor has seen a clean-one site on the same host, it needs {after} more.
twoLayers: It builds on {base}, so it reuses two layers.
newEls: {n} new packages in the 12 months to {date}.
elText: The most-used packages sit in the middle; everything around them builds on them. Most used by {date}: {top}. {ddd} of these {n} packages build on DDD. Hexagon size is each package’s main file, gzipped; a gold outline marks packages that 20 or more others use.
selectElement: Select an element to see what it depends on (orange) and what uses it (blue).
platText: They all work on one site format, site.json: some run sites, some build or edit them, and PRAW holds the rules for it.
platKey: Coloured: the properties in the HAX network bar, in their network colours. Grey: the platforms that run and build HAX. Size grows with commits to date; a ring pulses with each month’s commits.
selectPlat: Select one to see what it is for.
siteIntro: A visitor reads a few pages of one HAX site, then moves to the next site on the same host. Between pages of a site only the elements that page adds are fetched.
themeIntro: A visitor opens one HAX site after another on the same host, each on a different theme, in the order the themes were made.
firstStep: The first HAX page on a host fetches everything: {need} across {files} files.
laterStep: This step needs {need}; {cached} of it is already cached, so it fetches only {fetch}.
bundleSite: If every page were its own bundle
bundleTheme: If each site were its own bundle
unbundled: HAX: unbundled files, cached per file
cacheKey: Orange cells are fetched now, gold ones were already cached. Outlined cells are the shared core.
sources: Dates: when each file appeared at its current path, and each repository’s first commit. Bytes: gzip of each file’s source, file by file, with third-party code left out. Browsers keep one cache per site, so savings between sites apply on the same host.
drawing: {view} on {date}: {n} shown. The panel beside it lists the same figures.
slowed: Playback slowed 30× for the last month
